arms_at_sides.description: Arms hanging loose at the sides. Relaxed, open, or maybe just spaced out.

folded_hands.description: Hands clasped together in front. Demure, careful, or maybe just shy.

hand_on_hip.description: One hand cocked on the hip, the other arm loose. Self-assured, sassy, or maybe just aloof.

hands_on_hips.description: Both hands planted on the hips, elbows out. Bold, commanding, or maybe just silly.

crossed_arms.description: Arms folded across the chest. Closed off, defensive, or maybe just confident.

clutching_arm.description: One hand gripping the opposite arm. Nervous, self-soothing, or maybe just creepy.

one_arm_crossed_other_up.description: One arm braced under the chest, the other hand raised near the face. Theatrical, thoughtful, or maybe just a worrier.

hand_on_chest.description: One hand resting over the heart. Earnest, easygoing, or maybe just arrogant.

bold.description: Standing with legs apart and arms at the sides. Assertive, poised, or maybe just rude.

hands_behind_back.description: Hip cocked and hands hidden behind the back. Playful, coy, or maybe a little mysterious.
